This page is for discussion about Lojban morphology analysis programs. An initial paper is in a [[:morho.txt|separate text file]]. Comments to paragraphs 2.2.2 and 2.2.3 are especially wanted. For those of you who doesn't use Vim, an example of syntax plugin output as a html file is attached, see [[:File|xample.jbo.html|Morphology analysis programs comparison]]. See also [[BPFK Section: Formal Morphology]].

Update: after some discussion with xorxes, new version of Vim syntax plugin was created. In particular, case 2.2.2 was fixed.
